loop_core_pr.current_credit_semantics: after receiver use and verified outcome the turn marks causal_credit as BOUND_TO_EPISODE, then creates delta_hash and bound re-entry; no numeric credit score is persisted
loop_core_pr.learning_admission: only after provenance-bound re-entry plus terminal DONE

reward_contract.requires: causal_credit in [0,1] and material_learning_weight = confidence * causal_credit

gap: Current producer-owned terminal state proves that a verified outcome is bound to a causal episode, but does not prove a calibrated fractional causal contribution. Mapping BOUND_TO_EPISODE directly to causal_credit=1.0 would silently promote binary attribution into maximal numeric credit. Accepting a caller-supplied float would re-open reward laundering.

hypotheses.claim: Add a producer-owned CausalCreditReceipt with effect/outcome/episode/signal/causal identities, score, method, uncertainty, counterfactual/control basis and provenance; reward plasticity consumes only this verified receipt after DONE.

For v0.1, calibrated fractional credit may be unnecessary complexity; exact verified bound attribution could be a binary material-learning admission gate while magnitude/confidence is determined elsewhere.
If neither calibrated nor defensible binary attribution is available, persistent reward update should abstain rather than infer credit from mere activity or successful outcome.

strongest_counterhypothesis: A numeric credit score can itself become an ungrounded proxy and add false precision. The simpler binary verified-attribution gate may be safer and sufficient until lesion/counterfactual evidence supports fractional credit.

required_discriminator.name: BINARY_VS_FRACTIONAL_CAUSAL_CREDIT_REPLAY
metrics: calibration against known synthetic causal contributions
